name: OSINT — Passive Web Infrastructure
description: Passive, non-intrusive infrastructure mapping and attribution with temporal context.

tasks.name: Define lawful passive scope
tasks.objective: Define seed domains/services, research question, relevant dates, and explicit non-intrusive boundary: public records and passively collected datasets only; no active vulnerability scanning, authentication attempts, credential testing, exploitation, or bypassing access controls.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Scope explicitly excludes active access or exploitation.

tasks.name: Collect domain identity records
tasks.objective: Collect RDAP/WHOIS history where lawful, registrar/registry data, nameservers, DNS records from passive sources, certificate-transparency records, public contact/organization data, and domain creation/change history. Preserve collection dates and historical validity.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Current and historical records are not conflated.

tasks.name: Map hosting and network relationships
tasks.objective: Map IP history, ASN, hosting/CDN/proxy providers, mail infrastructure, nameserver clusters, certificates, subdomains exposed through passive datasets, and public service metadata. Distinguish shared-provider infrastructure from organization-controlled infrastructure.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Shared cloud/CDN identifiers are not treated as ownership proof.

tasks.name: Recover historical web footprint
tasks.objective: Use web archives, public repositories, cached documentation, package metadata, public configuration references, favicon/content hashes from passive indexes where lawful, and historical DNS/certificates to reconstruct how infrastructure changed over time.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Historical relationships carry date ranges and source provenance.

tasks.name: Correlate attribution signals
tasks.objective: Correlate distinctive certificate subjects, analytics IDs, public contact addresses, repository references, nameserver patterns, historical co-hosting, branding/content, and administrative records. Weight shared commoditized signals weakly and independent distinctive signals strongly.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Attribution uses multiple independent indicators and states plausible alternatives.

tasks.name: Falsify attribution
tasks.objective: Search for benign shared-hosting, reseller, registrar privacy, CDN, template, analytics reuse, domain sale, expired-domain reuse, certificate automation, and historical ownership explanations that could create false associations.

acceptanceCriteria.description: High-confidence attribution survives commodity-infrastructure alternative explanations.

tasks.name: Package passive map
tasks.objective: Deliver a dated infrastructure graph, source/provenance ledger, confidence per relationship, historical changes, rejected associations, and explicit statement that no active access/scanning was performed.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every edge is sourced and temporally bounded where data permits.
